result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the promotional banner has a significant contrast problem: white text is used on a very light mint-green background, making the headline, promo code details, and even the 'Order now' button text hard to read.

issues.description: The promotional banner text ('3 free deliveries for you', 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10', and the 'Order now' button label) is white on a very light mint-green background, resulting in very low contrast and poor readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or switch the text to a dark color (e.g., dark green/near-black) to ensure sufficient contrast, especially for the promo code line and the 'Order now' button label.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is fairly light gray on a light background, slightly reducing readability.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast of the light-gray placeholder text against the input background.
